name: Pakistan Code (consolidated federal laws)
label: Pakistan
record_note: The Pakistan Code publishes only the current consolidated PDF of each federal law, so each law has one version here: the text as retrieved on 2026-10-28. There is no line-by-line history before that day. The amendment footnotes are kept as text and in data/amendments.csv. The site says its laws are under review and for information only; the Gazette of Pakistan is authoritative.

dates.commit: the day the PDFs were retrieved
dates.time: 12:00 Pakistan time (UTC+5; UTC+6 in the daylight-saving periods of 2002, 2008 and 2009)

author.consolidated: Pakistan Code (Ministry of Law and Justice)
author.unexplained: Pakistan Code (Ministry of Law and Justice)

scope.when_absent: not extracted for Pakistan; savings and transitional rules are in the amending laws

default_reach.meaning: a repeal does not affect anything done, rights acquired or proceedings pending under the repealed law unless a different intention appears
default_reach.authority: General Clauses Act, 1897, section 6 (effect of repeal)
